name: durable-streams
description: Durable Streams server implementation and storage adapters.

scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run lint:general && bun run lint:effect
scripts.lint:effect: oxlint --config .oxlintrc.effect.json packages/streams packages/projection packages/sinks packages/state-sink packages/effect-sink packages/views packages/views-store examples/fold-agent examples/hackernews-newest-stream examples/issue-tracker examples/issue-tracker-projections examples/risk-demo
scripts.lint:fix: bun run lint:general:fix && bun run lint:effect:fix
scripts.lint:effect:fix: oxlint --config .oxlintrc.effect.json packages/streams packages/projection packages/sinks packages/state-sink packages/effect-sink packages/views packages/views-store examples/fold-agent examples/hackernews-newest-stream examples/issue-tracker examples/issue-tracker-projections examples/risk-demo --fix
scripts.test:conformance: bun run test:conformance:client && bun run test:conformance:memory && bun run test:conformance:fs && bun run test:conformance:sqlite && bun run test:conformance:do
scripts.test:unit: bun run --cwd packages/core test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/http-client test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/json test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/views-ir test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/views test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/views-engine test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/views-store test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/streams test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/projection test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/state test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/state-sink test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/sinks test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/effect-sink test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/tanstack-db test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/storage-sqlite test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/storage-fs test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/storage-durable-object test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/conformance-tests test:unit && bun run --cwd examples/fold-agent test:unit
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/http-client build && bun run --cwd packages/json build && bun run --cwd packages/views-ir build && bun run --cwd packages/views build && bun run --cwd packages/views-engine build && bun run --cwd packages/views-store build && bun run --cwd packages/streams build && bun run --cwd packages/projection build && bun run --cwd packages/state build && bun run --cwd packages/state-sink build && bun run --cwd packages/sinks build && bun run --cwd packages/effect-sink build && bun run --cwd packages/tanstack-db build && bun run --cwd packages/storage-sqlite build && bun run --cwd packages/storage-fs build && bun run --cwd packages/storage-durable-object build
scripts.pack:dry-run: for dir in packages/core packages/http-client packages/json packages/views-ir packages/views packages/views-engine packages/views-store packages/streams packages/projection packages/state packages/state-sink packages/sinks packages/effect-sink packages/tanstack-db packages/storage-sqlite packages/storage-fs packages/storage-durable-object; do (cd "$dir" && bun pm pack --dry-run); done
